name: ui-tick
prompt: A single soft wooden UI tick, like a fingertip tapping a small lacquered wooden button, very short and quiet.

name: palette-select
prompt: A gentle dab of a brush picking up paint from a palette well, soft plastic click with a light wet paint dab, short.

name: paint-fill-1
prompt: A short soft brush stroke spreading wet paint across textured watercolor paper, one smooth swipe.

name: paint-fill-2
prompt: A quick spongy dab of acrylic paint pressed onto paper, soft wet press and release.

name: paint-fill-3
prompt: Soft bristles dragging thick pigment in one short stroke over coarse paper, gentle scrape.

name: paint-fill-4
prompt: A light roller of paint gliding briefly over paper with a soft creamy wet sound.

name: paper-undo
prompt: A piece of paper being gently peeled back from a stack, soft papery rustle, brief lifting undo sound.

name: hint-chime
prompt: A single soft glass chime note with a gentle shimmer, friendly and quiet, suggesting a hint.

name: invalid-thud
prompt: A dull soft double knock on cardboard, muted and low, a gentle not-allowed thud.

name: level-complete
prompt: A warm rising four-note marimba flourish with a soft paper rustle, a small gentle celebration finish.

name: moves-exhausted
prompt: A soft descending two-note wooden tone, like a small calm sigh, low and ending quietly.

name: achievement-chime
prompt: Two bright sparkling bell notes in quick succession with a light shimmer tail, a small reward jingle.
